title: Huh? (Dog)
blurb: The Huh? dog — canine confusion, captured perfectly. Where the huh cat is baffled, the huh dog is personally concerned about what you just said. It's the reaction for statements that require a double-take: sudden plans, weird requests, math. Play it and let the dog's face do the interrogating. The confusion is mutual and it is adorable.
